description: This file defines a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named AdminPanel, handling UI events and server-side navigation within an online examination system.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: A code-behind class for the Admin Panel web page, handling various button click events to navigate between pages.

methods.description: Event handler for the page load event, currently empty.
